text:
PROFILE::vdi
Description
Returns the value of a VDI profile setting.
Syntax
PROFILE
::
vdi
<
ATTR
>
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"\[PROFILE::vdi msrdp_ntlm_auth_name\]:    [PROFILE::vdi msrdp_ntlm_auth_name]"
log
local0.
"\[PROFILE::vdi citrix_storefront_replacement\]:   [PROFILE::vdi citrix_storefront_replacement]"
}
Related Information
